chunks: And by his chain, he said:
Were it not for the insistence of the believers upon Allah in seeking sustenance, He would transfer them from the condition they are in to a condition more constricted than it.

key_terms.إِلْحَاحُ: earnest persistence and repeated pleading in supplication
key_terms.اللَّهِ: Allah, the one to whom sustenance is sought
key_terms.الْحَالِ: the condition or state of a person
key_terms.الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: the believers, those characterized by iman

ai.seo_question: How does persistent du'a affect a believer's sustenance according to Imam al-Sadiq (عليه السلام)?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches that the believers’ persistent du'a to Allah concerning sustenance has a real effect in warding off greater constriction in their livelihood. It highlights both dependence upon Allah and the spiritual importance of earnest supplication in matters of provision.

en.hubeali: ‘Had it not been for the pleading of the Momineen to Allahazwj regarding seeking of the sustenance, Heazwj would have Transferred them from a state which they were in to a state more constricted than it’.
en.sarwar: 5. Through his chain of narrators (Ali ibn Ib

ahim) has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) has said, ‘Had it not been due to the believers’ pleading before Allah to increase their sustenance, He would have moved them to a poorer condition.’”
